Cricket Australia Opens Big Bash League to Private Investment

Cricket Australia has agreed to allow private investment in its Big Bash League (BBL) T20 competition. This move begins with the sale of the Melbourne Renegades franchise, which is currently owned by Cricket Victoria. The Renegades were BBL champions in the 2018-19 season. This decision opens the league to private investors.
